name: Sophia Reynolds
quote: PocketSmart AI took the overwhelm out of furnishing our new 3-bedroom apartment. By inputting our budget and room requirements, it gave us a harmonious modern Scandinavian aesthetic that kept us precisely within our $4,500 limit!

name: Marcus & Elena Vance
quote: Planning our 60-guest engagement party seemed impossible until we used the Party Budget Planner. The breakdown for catering, venue, and a 10% contingency buffer prevented unexpected hidden expenses.

name: Devon Patel
quote: The jewelry curation algorithm is surprisingly astute. It paired my anniversary budget with timeless 18K yellow gold pieces and provided genuine styling guidance that made selecting a gift effortless.

name: Clara Lindqvist
quote: The lighting and furniture suggestions strike the perfect balance between design sophistication and cost consciousness. Being able to bookmark items to my wishlist and export plans is a huge plus.

name: Julian Thorne
quote: Having a clear per-guest catering metric combined with entertainment and photography tiers allowed us to present a crisp, transparent budget to leadership in under ten minutes.
